changelog:
skill-factory 1.0.0

- Initial release of skill-factory, the meta-skill for designing and building new OpenClaw skills from any domain or task.
- Introduces a comprehensive 7-phase Skill Creation Protocol—from needs analysis and architecture design to quality assurance and delivery.
- Provides detailed guidance on skill structure (SKILL.md, references, templates, README), user personas, lifecycle mapping, and success criteria.
- Includes strict safety guardrails to prevent credential exposure and require user verification for sensitive actions.
- Equips agents with frameworks, templates, and audit processes to ensure all generated skills are robust, high-quality, and production-ready.
summary: The ultimate meta-skill for creating new OpenClaw skills from scratch. This skill transforms any agent into a world-class skill architect capable of designing, building, and shipping legendary-tier skills. Use this skill whenever you need to create a new skill — whether for writing, coding, research, analysis, creative work, or any domain. The factory produces skills that are structured, intelligent, robust, and ready for production. Think of it as a "skill compiler" that takes a domain description and outputs a complete, elite-tier skill package.
